+        try:
+            parsed = _datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
+            break
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    if parsed is None:
+        for pattern in ("%Y%m%d", "%Y-%m-%d"):
+            try:
+                parsed = _datetime.datetime.strptime(text[:10], pattern)
+                break
+            except ValueError:
+                pass
+    if parsed is None:
+        raise ValueError("unsupported event date: %r" % value)
+    if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
+        return int(parsed.timestamp())
+    return int((parsed - _datetime.datetime(1970, 1, 1)).total_seconds())
+
+
+def _recency_bin(delta_seconds):
+    days = delta_seconds / 86400.0
+    if days <= 1:
+        return 1
+    if days <= 3:
+        return 2
+    if days <= 7:
+        return 3
+    if days <= 14:
+        return 4
+    if days <= 30:
+        return 5
+    if days <= 90:
+        return 6
+    return 7
